quote:
Under FLR, planted forests, particularly afforestation,
should not replace existing native tropical grasslands,
wetlands or savanna ecosystems.

context.practice_as_described: Planted forests under forest landscape restoration; safeguard against replacing native non-forest ecosystems
context.numeric_calibration: Categorical safeguard only; no score, threshold, weight or EO class crosswalk supplied. Native ecosystem identity needs local habitat history and validation.
context.note: Applies to active planting that would convert these existing native ecosystems. Does not prohibit restoring degraded native wetland forest or establish a legal protected-area mask. Source includes broader FLR practices; only the explicit planted-forest safeguard is admitted.
context.intended_use: T4 habitat eligibility evidence pending human review; no automatically executable mask
context.review_needed: Confirm source-scope application and native ecosystem mapping before compilation.

attribution: ITTO2020 guiding element GE20; normative international guidance, no separate empirical calibration asserted.
